title: ETA 24/0895: European Technical Assessment for Terasun TSM Fiber Cement Board
description: What ETA 24/0895 means for Terasun TSM fiber cement board: scope, declared performances, validity, and how to use it in building specifications across Europe.
author: Terasun Europe Technical Team
body:
## ETA 24/0895: European Technical Assessment for Fiber Cement Board

### What is a European Technical Assessment (ETA)?

A European Technical Assessment (ETA) is a formal technical document issued under the Construction Products Regulation (EU) No 305/2011 (CPR). It enables manufacturers to CE-mark construction products that are not fully covered by a harmonised European standard.

For Terasun TSM fiber cement board, **ETA 24/0895** was issued following assessment of the product's performance characteristics relevant to its intended uses: facade systems, wet rooms, and fire-rated wall assemblies.

---

### Scope of ETA 24/0895

ETA 24/0895 covers **Terasun TSM fiber cement board** — an inorganic building board manufactured from Portland cement, inorganic fillers, and reinforcing fibres (no asbestos). The assessment covers the following intended uses:

1. **Ventilated facade systems** — as a facade board in drained and ventilated cladding systems
2. **Wet rooms and bathrooms** — as a tile backing board and sheathing in areas of high moisture exposure
3. **Fire-rated wall assemblies** — as part of tested wall systems achieving E 120 / EI 90 / EW 120

---

### Declared Performance Characteristics

The ETA confirms the following declared performance values for Terasun TSM 12 mm board:

| Characteristic | Performance | Test Standard |
|---|---|---|
| Moisture classification | Category A | EN 12467 |
| Reaction to fire | A1 | EN 13501-1 |
| Fire resistance (wall assembly) | E 120 / EI 90 / EW 120 | EN 13501-2 |
| Weight | 9.96 kg/m² | Declared |
| Format | 1,220 × 2,440 mm | Declared |
| Available thicknesses | 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 18 mm | Declared |

*Note: Fire classification E120/EI90/EW120 applies to the specific tested wall assembly using 12 mm boards, not to the board alone. See fire test report FIRES-CR-284-25-AUPE for system details.*

---

### CE Marking Reference

The CE marking for Terasun TSM board issued under ETA 24/0895 is:

**CE 1023-CPR-1565 P**

This CE marking is supported by:
- **Declaration of Performance (DoP):** TRS-20250610F
- **Environmental Product Declaration (EPD):** EPD-IES-0018268 (ISO 14025)
- **Fire test report:** FIRES-CR-284-25-AUPE

---

### Why ETA Matters for Specifiers

**Legal compliance under CPR:** The Construction Products Regulation requires CE marking for construction products covered by a harmonised standard or ETA. Products without CE marking cannot be legally placed on the EU/EEA market for regulated uses.

**Building permit documentation:** Many EU member state building authorities require ETA documentation as part of building permit applications, especially for products used in facades or fire-rated constructions.

**Structural engineers and fire engineers:** The ETA provides the declared performance values that structural and fire engineers need when designing systems using Terasun TSM board.

**Insurance and warranty:** Most European building insurers and warranty providers require products to carry CE marking and have ETA or harmonised standard compliance documentation.

---

### How to Reference ETA 24/0895 in Specifications

When specifying Terasun TSM fiber cement board in project documentation:

```
Fiber cement board: Terasun TSM, CE 1023-CPR-1565 P, ETA 24/0895,
DoP TRS-20250610F, EN 12467 Category A, Reaction to fire A1,
Thickness: [specify], Format: 1,220 × 2,440 mm.
Supplied by Terasun Europe (Authorised European Representative),
Vantaa, Finland.
```

---

faq.a: ETA 24/0895 is the European Technical Assessment for Terasun TSM fiber cement board. It is issued under the Construction Products Regulation and enables CE marking (CE 1023-CPR-1565 P) for facade, wet room, and fire-rated wall applications.
ETA 24/0895 covers Terasun TSM fiber cement board in thicknesses 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, and 18 mm, with standard format 1,220 × 2,440 mm.

faq.q: Do I need the ETA for a building permit?
faq.a: In most EU/EEA countries, the CE marking (supported by the ETA and DoP) is required for regulated construction products. Many building permit applications require the ETA or DoP as supporting documentation. Contact Terasun Europe for a full documentation pack.
